gh-dxt.scope: 第 11 章的分发包对照：插件包该装什么、如何声明依赖与入口，这套规范与 Claude Code 自己的插件格式并列，能看出「能力封装单位」的两种边界。

gh-codex.scope: 第 4 章的对照面：另一家在本地跑编码智能体的公司，把沙箱与审批做成独立一层，Rust 实现；同一组「谁被允许动什么」的问题，它在配置与策略文件上的答案与本书所讲的权限流水线并不相同。
gh-codex.scope_en: A cross-check for Chapter 4: another company running a coding agent locally, with sandboxing and approvals split into their own layer in Rust. Asked the same question of who may touch what, it answers with config and policy files shaped quite differently from the permission pipeline this book describes.

gh-learn-cc.title: Learn Claude Code — Harness Engineering
gh-learn-cc.snapshot: 2026-10-26 读取（GitHub API：无 release，钉 main 分支当时 HEAD，最近推送 2026-09-28，约 79.2k star；README 有英/中/日三语）
gh-learn-cc.snapshot_en: 2026-10-26 read (GitHub API: no releases, so the pin is main's HEAD at that date; pushed 2026-09-28, ~79.2k stars; the README ships in English, Chinese and Japanese)
gh-learn-cc.scope: 第 1、15 章的同类教材：它把「智能体 = 模型 + 线束」当作开场论证，再一层层从零搭出对话循环、工具、权限与会话——与本书的拆法几乎同构，可作独立对照。
gh-learn-cc.scope_en: A kindred text for Chapters 1 and 15: it opens by arguing that an agent is a model plus a harness, then rebuilds the dialog loop, tools, permissions and sessions from nothing. Its decomposition is close enough to the book's to serve as an independent second read of the same layers.

gh-superpowers.scope: 第 9、11 章的现成证据：一整套开发方法论被装成可组合的 skills、子智能体与入口指令，同一份包在十来个宿主上分发——能力封装单位能长多大，这是目前最有说服力的一个样本。
gh-superpowers.scope_en: Existing evidence for Chapters 9 and 11: a whole development methodology packaged as composable skills, subagents and entry instructions, with the same bundle distributed across a dozen hosts -- the strongest sample yet of how large a unit of capability packaging can grow.

gh-claude-mem.scope: 第 6、7 章的压力测试：把「记住」做成线束外的一层，靠自己摘要或外部后端把旧内容压回上下文——正好与本书的四级压缩路线争同一块预算，是检验那套账算得对不对的活样本。
gh-claude-mem.scope_en: A stress test for Chapters 6 and 7: it moves remembering outside the harness and presses old content back into context through its own summaries or an external backend, competing with the book's four-level compression route for the very same budget.
